inscription:
In good company, you and I
Bring one more friend to the club
A place for games and pizza
Invent a new tale, you and I

Make room for a bigger team
One more turn before we go
You might just win today
And laugh about the drama

Another round, another idea
Roll again and see things clearer
Open the box and give it a go
Zero rush, just a little buzz
